quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025): net sales and operating income were roughly flat year on year. Health Care and Homes grew, while Material sales and profit fell on lower petrochemical market prices, inventory valuation effects and scheduled turnarounds. Within Material, the Electronics business grew profit as AI-related products held firm; Car Interior, Energy & Infrastructure (lower ion-exchange membrane chlor-alkali plant sales), Comfort Life, Performance Chemicals and Essential Chemicals declined.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 1,486,368 million (H1 FY2025: JPY 1,490,334 million); operating income JPY 107,454 million; Material segment net sales JPY 637,844 million, segment operating income JPY 30,953 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex and R&D in H1 FY2026: capital expenditure of JPY 90,265 million against a full-year plan of JPY 233,000 million, with Material at JPY 59,271 million of a JPY 173,000 million plan (Hipore lithium-ion battery separator coating capacity and an integrated film-forming / coating line, hydroelectric plant refurbishment) and Health Care at JPY 13,839 million of JPY 32,000 million (Bionova CDMO capacity, new Planova spinning plant); no material change to the plan. R&D expenses for the half were JPY 52,890 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 capex JPY 90,265 million; full-year plan JPY 233,000 million (Material JPY 173,000 million); H1 R&D JPY 52,890 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Health Care structure change in H1: after Asahi Kasei Medical (dialysis and apheresis) accepted preferred equity and the company transferred part of its shares, Asahi Kasei Medical and four consolidated subsidiaries left consolidation; Asahi Kasei Medical and Asahi Kasei Medical MT are now equity-method affiliates.
